useradd --system --home-dir /var/lib/z --shell /usr/sbin/nologin zero
install -d -m 0755 /var/lib
fallocate -l 4294967296 /var/lib/z.img
chmod 0600 /var/lib/z.img
mkfs.ext4 -q -m 0 -L zero-state /var/lib/z.img
install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/z
write /etc/systemd/system/var-lib-z.mount
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now var-lib-z.mount
install -d -m 0755 /opt/zero /opt/zero/releases /opt/zero/etc
install verified release and retained seed sources
install -d -m 0755 /opt/zero/node
install verified Node archive
write recipe.json, seed.json and zero launcher
write accounts.json (1 account)
install -d -o root -g root -m 0700 /etc/zero
head -c 32 /dev/urandom > /etc/zero/master.key
chmod 0400 /etc/zero/master.key
Back up /etc/zero/master.key; without it the sealed secrets are unrecoverable.
install -d -m 0755 /etc/systemd/system
write /etc/systemd/system/zero.service
write /etc/systemd/system/zero-update.service
write /etc/systemd/system/zero-update.timer
systemctl daemon-reload
chown -R zero:zero /var/lib/z
chown root:zero /opt/zero/releases
chmod 1775 /opt/zero/releases
write install.json
systemctl enable --now zero.service
systemctl enable --now zero-update.timer
